title: Al'arshi Da Ya Yi Tafiya Nan Take
intro: Wani mutum mai iko mai girma ya yi mulki a kan wata masarauta mai arziki da aka albarkace ta da wadata fiye da kima. Lokacin da wani ƙalubale da ba a zata ba ya taso, wannan mai mulki ya fuskanci gwaji ba ta takobi ba, sai ta hikima da imani. Abin da ya faru zai haifar daga kololuwar ikon duniya zuwa ga babban sauyi na zuciya.
clues: Na yi mulki a kan wata masarauta mai albarka da wadata da wadata fiye da tunanin da aka yi.
Ni sarki ne mai iko wanda ya sami wasiƙa mai ƙarfi da ke buƙatar a miƙa masa
Manyan mutanena sun ba ni shawara game da ko zan yi yaƙi ko in yi sulhu da wannan sarkin nesa.
Na tashi da kyaututtuka masu kyau domin in hadu da wannan sarkin nesa da kaina
An kawo gadon sarautata zuwa wata ƙasa mai nisa a cikin ƙiftawar ido, kafin in iya dawowa.
Lokacin da na shiga fada mai santsi kamar gilashi, a ƙarshe na yi shelar sallamata ga Allah

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَـٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
verse: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh]. (27:42)
